claims.claim: The full early-window model discriminates collapse from persistence on unseen conditions (test AUC >= 0.70, cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0.50).
claims.detail: test AUC 0.885 [0.825, 0.941] on 92 labelled runs (59 collapses).

claims.claim: The full model beats the population-size-plus-trend baseline by at least 0.05 AUC and has Brier skill >= 0.10.
The full model remains calibrated on unseen conditions (ECE <= 0.10 and calibration slope in [0.5, 1.5]).
claims.detail: ECE 0.250; calibration slope 379685.813, intercept -15268131.603; Brier 0.244 vs base 0.230.

claims.claim: Entropy alone is not a universal collapse indicator: the entropy-only model fails the same discrimination bar (AUC < 0.70).
claims.detail: entropy-only test AUC 0.812 [0.733, 0.881]; full minus entropy delta 0.073 [0.027, 0.156].

claims.claim: Spatial structure adds predictive value beyond population and temporal features (full minus temporal AUC >= 0.05, bootstrap lower bound > 0).
claims.detail: full minus temporal delta AUC 0.110 [0.046, 0.238] (temporal AUC 0.775).
